game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Ragenglion
quote:
This is a slide show with its low fps dipping into the 20s. It focuses too much on realism to an absolute fault. It took the worst aspects of rdr2 and removed the best aspects of gta 5.  There are protected classes you cannot commit crimes against and there are severe limitations on cars you can steal. And its boring

Also that lucia lady abandons your kid and you cannot legally get your son back. She causes most of the plot problems. And you cannot throw her tied to an anchor into the ocean
